title: Automate changelog and onboard nova-tera-13b v1.1 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Sofia Patel
description: Onboard nova-tera-13b v1.1 into the model registry and add automated changelog/release-notes generation. Motivation: Nova-Tera 13b v1.1 includes quantization-friendly weights and improved kv-cache layout that gives better latency at 8-bit. This PR adds model metadata (manifest + tags), performance profiles for common deployment types (hosted/dedicated/private), and a GitHub Action that auto-generates a changelog entry from model metadata and perf profile diffs when a model onboarding PR is merged. Changes include metadata YAML, perf profile JSONs, registry index update, validation schema and CI hooks. Checklist: - [x] Add model manifest (metadata) with versioning and compatibility tags; - [x] Add performance profiles (nv4a, a10, h100) with latency/throughput snapshots; - [x] Add automated changelog generator GitHub Action and unit tests; - [x] Add schema validations and a lightweight perf regression check that blocks merge on obvious regressions; - [x] Update docs template for model onboarding; - [x] Run end-to-end onboarding job on staging and verify artifacts. See commits and file list for details. Related: Linear ENG-4821, ENG-4970.

release_notes: Onboard nova-tera-13b v1.1: add metadata manifest, performance profiles for NV4A/A10G/H100, and automated changelog generation. Performance improvements: ~12% lower latency on H100-32 at 2048 tokens compared to v1.0; new conservative profiles for production safety. Added CI validation for perf profile schema and perf-diff checks to prevent regressions.
performance_profiles_summary: nv4a-8: p50=45ms p95=82ms throughput=260 tok/s; a10g-16: p50=32ms p95=60ms throughput=420 tok/s (conservative: p50=38ms p95=72ms); h100-32: p50=18ms p95=32ms throughput=980 tok/s
changelog_automation_details: Adds .github/workflows/generate-changelog.yml which runs on model-registry PR merges and on tag creation. The workflow invokes tools/changelog-generator/cli.py which reads manifest.yaml and perf-profiles to produce a standardized CHANGELOG entry and opens a PR against redwood-docs/changelog with the proposed release notes. The action supports dry-run mode for staging and includes a perf-diff threshold config to block noisy changes.
test_plan: Unit tests for perf-profile schema validator (tools/perf-validator/tests)
Integration: run onboarding job on staging cluster and validate artifacts uploaded to staging registry
E2E: run changelog-action dry-run and verify PR created against docs repo
Manual: reproduce perf numbers using harness-config.yaml on nv4a and a10g staging machines
notes: This PR intentionally includes both the onboarding artifacts and automation to reduce manual steps for future onboards. If rollout causes friction we can split automation into a follow-up, but having the validator land with the model reduces risk of unvalidated profiles.
